pages.title: Wakizashi
pages.text: Wakizashi-type sword warriors. Sword warriors of the same type have basically no difference in attack speed, search range, attack power, and movement speed.

pages.name: Nikkari Aoe
pages.text: A large wakizashi made by the Aoe school of Bitchu province. It was originally an odachi but was shortened to its current form. This famous blade is said to have a history of slaying ghosts, and it always carries an aura of mystery.

pages.name: Horikawa Kunihiro
pages.text: A wakizashi said to have been forged by the swordsmith Horikawa Kunihiro, who was active during the Azuchi-Momoyama period. It is said to have been the beloved blade of Vice-Commander Hijikata Toshizo of the Shinsengumi. He is the partner and assistant of Izuminokami Kanesada. Beneath his polite and considerate demeanor lies a burning fighting spirit.
